title: Rayleigh-Ritz Variational Method in The Complex Plane
summary: We present a systematic study of the Rayleigh--Ritz variational method for quantum oscillators in the Segal--Bargmann space. We rigorously derive the normalizability condition $|α| < \tfrac{1}{2}$ for generalized Gaussian trial functions $ψ(z) = e^{αz^2 + βz}$ through convergence analysis of Gaussian integrals in the complex plane. Applications to the harmonic oscillator demonstrate exact recovery of the ground state in Segal--Bargmann space when the trial family contains the true solution.
